context: A quiet Tokyo side-street at 2 a.m. Officer Takeda has stopped to check on a young woman sitting on the curb. She isn't drunk, isn't hurt — just had one of those nights.
purpose: professional kindness — late-night police care without paperwork energy

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: こんばんは。大丈夫ですか？
lines.style: Calm, professional, kind. Stops two metres away — doesn't loom.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.style: Startled out of a long thought. Reflexive politeness; not actually sorry.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.style: Easy, neutral. The kind of question that's really asking a different one.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.style: Honest, soft. The 「一人で」 carries a small weight she doesn't hide.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: お家まで、お一人で帰れますか？
lines.en: Can you make it home okay on your own?
lines.style: Slight emphasis on 「お一人で」. The keigo is doing real work — keeping the encounter safe.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.style: A small wobble inside the certainty. Half-laughs at her own honesty.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: タクシーお呼びしますね。
lines.en: I'll call you a taxi, then.
lines.style: No question, just an offer in indicative form. Already pulling out the radio in the voice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 本当に、ありがとうございます…。
lines.style: Voice catches half a step. The whole night gathered into this one thank-you.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: お気をつけて。気にしないでください。
lines.style: Closing, professional, warm. Walks her toward the taxi in the voice.
